title: Which script produces this output?
examObjective: Converting between output types and data types using DataWeave
prompt:
The output is XML with `indent=false, writeDeclaration=false`. Given the payload below,

**which script produces exactly this output?**

```
<items><item sku="A">1</item><item sku="B">2</item></items>
```

options:
%dw 2.0
output application/xml indent=false, writeDeclaration=false
---
{ items: { (payload.items map { item @(sku: $.sku): $.qty }) } }

%dw 2.0
output application/xml indent=false, writeDeclaration=false
---
{ items: { (payload.items map { item: $.qty }) } }

%dw 2.0
output application/xml indent=false, writeDeclaration=false
---
{ (payload.items map { item @(sku: $.sku): $.qty }) }

%dw 2.0
output application/xml indent=false, writeDeclaration=false
---
{ items: { (payload.items map { item @(sku: $.qty): $.sku }) } }

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/xml indent=false, writeDeclaration=false
---
{ items: { (payload.items map { item @(sku: $.sku): $.qty }) } }

explanation.approach: Each row becomes one `item` element, spread into a single `items` root with `{( )}`. The attribute goes in `@( )` after the key and the element text after the colon. Without the root, the writer would have to write two top-level elements.

snippets.label: The answer
snippets.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/xml indent=false, writeDeclaration=false
---
{ items: { (payload.items map { item @(sku: $.sku): $.qty }) } }
snippets.note: One root, repeated children, one attribute each.
